method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Wall St Week Ahead Nvidia earnings, Jackson Hole to test pillars of stock rally
Equities.reason: Frames the dominant near-term equity narrative: AI leadership (Nvidia) versus macro/rate risk (Jackson Hole). Important market-moving theme that increases downside risk if policymakers signal higher-for-longer rates.

Equities.title: Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq open higher as Treasury selloff takes a breather
Equities.reason: Short-term positive for equities as bond-market pressure eases briefly; highlights sensitivity of stocks to Treasury moves and liquidity conditions.

Equities.title: Allspring’s Miletti Sees Jackson Hole as Bigger Risk Than Nvidia
Equities.reason: Investor view emphasising macro/rate-event risk (Jackson Hole) over single-stock/AI tailwinds — reinforces a cautious equity stance tied to central bank signalling and yields.

Equities.title: Energy sector is in focus because of Iran, AI and California. Here are hedge funds' top plays
Equities.summary: The favorite energy stocks of hedge funds - including one with a projected 65% upside
Equities.reason: Sector-rotation theme into energy (geopolitical risk, AI-driven infrastructure, California dynamics) — supportive for energy names but limited market-wide influence.

Equities.title: Anthropic IPO filing will show AI backlash as a risk factor, sources say
Equities.summary: Anthropic is poised to debut on the stock market at a time when the public is increasingly upset about data centers and is fearful about AI taking jobs.
Equities.reason: Highlights political/social risk to AI theme and potential headwinds for AI-related valuations and IPO market appetite — sector-specific but relevant to equity leadership narrative.

Equities.title: Ken Griffin says Citadel unwound more than 80% of risk tied to Situational Awareness portfolio
Equities.summary: Citadel has unwound more than 80% of the portfolio risk it acquired from Situational Awareness through over $4 billion in block trades, said Ken Griffin.
Equities.reason: De-risking by a major market participant reduces a potential source of market fragility; small positive for systemic risk/market stability but limited direct equity signal.

Equities.title: US equity funds draw inflows despite market pressures
Equities.reason: Net inflows suggest investor demand is underpinning equities even amid rate and geopolitical pressures — a meaningful supportive flow for the market regime.

Equities.title: Broadcom debt deal expected to reach upwards of $70 billion, sources say
Equities.summary: Broadcom is in talks to raise upwards of $70 to $80 billion in debt for a chip financing deal, CNBC's David Faber reported on Friday.
Equities.reason: Large financing for a major chip deal supports consolidation and AI-capacity narratives in tech, mildly positive for sector leadership but raises leverage/credit considerations.

Equities.title: UBS Global Wealth Management lifts S&P 500 year-end target to 8,100
Equities.reason: A major house raising its S&P target is a bullish signal for investor expectations and supports the narrative that valuation/earnings momentum could sustain equities, assuming macro risks don't worsen.

Rates.title: Bond Yields Rise Despite Treasury Efforts to Curb Borrowing Costs
Rates.reason: Core piece documenting that Treasury buybacks/intervention have not prevented yields from rising — reinforces dominant market narrative of a renewed bond selloff and higher-for-longer rates.

Rates.title: Warsh faces Fed independence test as Bessent moves in on central bank's turf
Rates.summary: Bessent’s effort to tamp down long-term Treasury yields could force Warsh to clarify how far the Fed should go in coordinating on bonds and the balance sheet.
Rates.reason: Highlights policy friction between Treasury intervention and Fed independence — increases uncertainty about durable policy to control yields, bearish for bond prices.

Rates.title: US Treasury yields extend rebound as Services PMI beats estimates
Rates.summary: US Treasury yields continue their recovery following the announcement of a bond buyback by the US Department of the Treasury, while data reveal that business activity remains solid despite a slowdown in manufacturing.
Rates.reason: Market-moving data and buyback context show yields rebounding after intervention — supports narrative of upward pressure on yields.

Rates.title: Bond yields give back almost all gains since Treasury intervention
Rates.reason: Explicitly notes reversal of earlier bond-market relief from Treasury buybacks — reinforces that intervention effects were temporary and yields resumed climbing.

Rates.title: Bessent's bond gambit aimed at calming markets is instead stirring inflation worries
Rates.summary: The so-called breakeven rate hit its highest levels in more than two months.
Rates.reason: Shows intervention may be lifting inflation breakevens and real-rate pressure — a meaningful undermining of long-end bond prospects and a driver of higher nominal yields.

Rates.title: US borrowing costs rise as attempts to ease rates prove short-lived
Rates.reason: Summarises that interventions failed to sustainably lower borrowing costs — consistent with market-wide rebound in yields and higher financing costs.

Rates.title: U.S. bond intervention is like 'paying your mortgage with your credit card,' JPMorgan's Sullivan says
Rates.summary: The U.S. government's efforts to manage pressure in the Treasury market risk merely shifting the problem down the road, according to JPMorgan's James Sullivan.
Rates.reason: Veteran market view that intervention is temporary and potentially counterproductive — a tactical but relevant bearish signal for bond markets.

Rates.title: The bond scare and the balance of power
Rates.summary: After the dreamworld of the 2010s, the link between power and fiscal capacity is back
Rates.reason: Macro commentary placing the bond move in a structural fiscal/policy context — elevates the story to a regime-level reassessment that favours higher yields and risk for fixed income.

Rates.title: Secretary Bessent ‘confident’ Treasury bond yields will continue declining
Rates.reason: Direct statement of Treasury intent to keep pushing buybacks and lower yields — represents a Treasury-side narrative but currently a lower-relevance, contrarian signal versus market actions.

FX.title: Forecasting the upcoming week: Warsh's Jackson Hole debut and US inflation test a soft US Dollar
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY) ended the week near even with Thursday, holding near 98.80. Like Thursday, DXY traded down to the 98.50s before recovering later in the session.
FX.reason: Explicit DXY/USD narrative calling out a 'soft US Dollar' ahead of major US events (Jackson Hole, inflation). Direct USD-centric FX piece shaping near-term USD risk—higher relevance.

FX.title: Higher yields stop paying the Dollar Index
FX.summary: The Dollar Index trades just beneath 99.00 and unchanged on the session, with the entire day fitting inside 35 pips between the 98.50 area and a high that stopped a shade short of the handle.
FX.reason: Notes disconnect between higher yields and DXY strength—supports USD weakness narrative even as bond markets move; directly relevant to USD/FX flows.

FX.title: US Buyback Pledge Draws Japan Comparisons and Pressures Dollar
FX.reason: Bloomberg piece ties a major US Treasury policy step (long-end buyback pledge) to USD downside—large macro policy move with clear FX transmission; high relevance and impact.

FX.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Bulls target YTD high after breakout
FX.summary: The Aussie Dollar finished the week with gains of over 0.82% on Friday and up more than 1.20% for the week as the US Dollar tumbled following the US Treasury Department's announcement of a bond buyback for the long end of the curve. The AUD/USD trades at 0.717
FX.reason: AUD strength explicitly linked to a softer USD after the US Treasury buyback announcement—direct USD-pair move consistent with the dominant USD-softening narrative.

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Bulls test 1.1700 as RSI turns overbought
FX.summary: EUR/USD heads for a fourth consecutive weekly gain on Friday, although it has erased its earlier intraday advance. At the time of writing, the pair trades around 1.1682 after briefly rising above 1.1700, its highest level since May 14.
FX.reason: EUR/USD pushing to multi-week highs—direct evidence of USD weakening and a core FX pair moving consistent with the broader Dollar narrative; technical note lowers maximum relevance slightly.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar extends rally as fading Fed-hike bets soften US Dollar
FX.summary: The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) extends its rally against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday, trading near 0.6000 and close to its highest level since end-May.
FX.reason: NZD rally explicitly tied to fading Fed-hike expectations and USD softening—supports cross-market narrative of lower USD driven by rate-expectation shifts.

FX.title: Mexican Peso reaches two-year high despite weaker Retail Sales
FX.summary: The Mexican currency appreciates to levels last seen in May 2024 as the USD/MXN falls to a two-year low as the US Dollar tumbles even though business activity in the services sector improved. The exotic pair trades at 16.92, down 0.22% for the week and 0.50% f
FX.reason: EMFX-specific move (MXN) driven by a weaker USD; relevant as corroborating evidence of broad USD softness but smaller idiosyncratic/EM weight reduces relevance.

FX.title: European Central Bank: Structural LTROs could ease funding pressure - Rabobank
FX.summary: Rabobank's Bas van Geffen, analyses how forthcoming structural Longer-term Refinancing Operations (LTROs) could complement the European Central Bank's (ECB) standard refinancing operations as excess liquidity declines.
FX.reason: ECB operational change (structural LTROs) could ease EUR funding pressure and be mildly supportive for EUR vs USD—relevant to EUR/USD but more technical and regional in scope.

FX.title: Malaysian Ringgit: Robust trade supports MYR – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Moses Lim notes Malaysia’s July exports rose 38.0% year-on-year, marking a fourth month of double‑digit growth led by electronics and machinery. The bank highlights resilient external demand, strong shipments to the US and China, and an AI‑driven
FX.reason: MYR support partly attributed to a softer USD and strong external demand—relevant as EMFX confirmation of USD weakness but country-specific fundamentals limit relevance.

FX.title: British Pound eases as UK sales drop, US services beat forecasts
FX.summary: The Pound Sterling (GBP) loses some ground against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday, though it remains poised to end the week with gains of over 0.60%, even as UK Retail Sales disappointed investors and US business activity improved in August.
FX.reason: Provides a near-term USD-strength counter-signal (US data supporting USD) versus the broader USD-soft narrative; included at lower relevance to reflect a meaningful cross-check.

Commodities.title: Gold rebounds as bond jitters, debt fears and weaker dollar revive bullion demand
Commodities.summary: Gold is rebounding as investors weigh U.S. debt concerns, a weaker dollar and stubbornly high Treasury yields.
Commodities.reason: Broad-market drivers (U.S. debt concerns, weaker USD, high yields) are clearly boosting safe-haven demand for gold — material commodity impact and high relevance to precious metals prices.

Commodities.title: Gold hits three-month peak above $4,600 as Middle East risks fuel rally
Commodities.summary: Gold price hits a three-month high and is poised to end the week with gains of over 5.6%, even though business activity in the services sector in the US was solid. Recent developments in the Middle East and a softer US Dollar underpin the yellow metal, which h
Commodities.reason: Middle East geopolitical risk + softer USD are a strong, market-moving bullish narrative for gold; price breakout to three-month highs increases relevance.

Commodities.title: Dalio Says Sell Bonds, Buy Gold, Bitcoin as Debt Crisis Looms
Commodities.reason: High-profile macro voice advocating gold as a hedge amplifies safe-haven flows into precious metals; sentiment signal that supports ongoing gold strength.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG bulls test $70 as rally extends
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) prices rally for the third straight day on Friday, up more than 2% and, for the week, gains over 7.40%, as a firm US Dollar (USD) is not an excuse for precious metals buyers, who are choosing flight-to-quality over haven demand due to the diff
Commodities.reason: Silver is rallying alongside gold on haven flows and weaker USD; as a price-forecast/technical piece its relevance is capped per framework but still positive for precious metals.

Commodities.title: Longer wells boost Permian crude oil and natural gas production
Commodities.summary: Well operators in the Permian region of western Texas and eastern New Mexico are getting more oil and gas out of the ground by drilling longer, horizontal wells and increasingly incorporating so-called super-lateral wells that exceed 15,000 feet.
Commodities.reason: Technology/operational improvements increasing US crude and gas output are a structural supply-side negative for energy prices, particularly U.S. barrels and gas.

Commodities.title: United States on track for record natural gas production in 2026
Commodities.summary: We forecast U.S. marketed natural gas production will average 122.5 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in 2026, surpassing the previous record of 118.5 Bcf/d set in 2025, in our August 2026 Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO).
Commodities.reason: Record U.S. gas production forecast is a significant bearish fundamental signal for natural gas prices and market balances.

Commodities.title: Waterborne shipments from the U.S. Gulf Coast increased in April and May
Commodities.summary: Waterborne shipments of crude oil and petroleum products from the U.S. Gulf Coast (PADD 3) to the West Coast (PADD 5) more than quadrupled year-on-year in April and May following a waiver that permitted a broader group of ships to travel between U.S. ports. Sh
Commodities.reason: Improved domestic waterborne flows reduce regional supply bottlenecks and are modestly bearish for US crude differentials and West Coast prices.

Commodities.title: China’s Oil Imports Set to Rebound as Refiners Hunt for New Supply
Commodities.reason: A rebound in Chinese crude imports would be a demand-side positive for oil, supporting prices given China's outsized role in global seaborne crude flows.

Commodities.title: U.S. military says it aided passage of 660 million barrels of oil through Strait of Hormuz since May
Commodities.summary: The security situation in Hormuz remains contested but the U.S. is helping oil get through the strait.
Commodities.reason: Military facilitation of shipments through Hormuz reduces the geopolitical supply premium — a modestly bearish signal for oil risk premia and prices.

Commodities.title: Iran grants permission for a number of Iraqi oil tankers to pass through Hormuz
Commodities.reason: Iran allowing Iraqi tankers through Hormuz lowers the chance of broader Strait disruptions — reduces immediate oil risk premium, modestly bearish for prices.

Commodities.title: Iranian Oil Supply to China Is Rapidly Drying Up
Commodities.reason: Reports of Iran-origin barrels to China falling materially are a demand/supply shift for regional crude flows and could support seaborne crude prices to the extent other suppliers don't fill the gap.

Crypto.title: How a Treasury buyback tweak helped bitcoin surge 25% to nearly $80,000 in days
Crypto.reason: Direct macro liquidity transmission (Treasury buybacks) appears to be fueling large BTC inflows and price discovery — a clear positive institutional/liquidity driver for crypto.

Crypto.title: Treasury buybacks could set up bitcoin’s next move toward $180,000, says strategist
Crypto.reason: Speculative price-target driven by the same Treasury buyback narrative; bullish but speculative so moderate relevance.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin tops $77,000 as best week since 2023 pulls altcoins along for the ride
Crypto.reason: Clear market momentum and breadth: BTC-led rally with altcoin participation reinforces risk-on, momentum-driven crypto flows.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin Surges as Institutional Demand, Short Covering, Clarity Act Progress Converge
Crypto.reason: Institutional demand, derivative short-covering and regulatory progress together are a high-impact, market-wide positive narrative for crypto.

Crypto.title: U.S. CFTC chief puts staff on notice to create crypto regulations if Clarity Act fails
Crypto.reason: Significant regulatory backstop risk: explicit agency readiness to act increases regulatory uncertainty/tail-risk if legislative clarity falters.

Crypto.title: Ripple SEC Case Becomes a Warning for Crypto Lawmakers
Crypto.reason: Ongoing SEC litigation themes create regulatory precedent risk across the industry — a material negative for crypto policy outlook and market sentiment.

Crypto.title: Binance Faces New Scrutiny in Its Crypto-Friendly UAE Haven
Crypto.reason: Exchange-level regulatory scrutiny in a major offshore hub raises counterparty/compliance risk for the market — negative for flow and sentiment.

Crypto.title: Nomura-backed Laser Digital wins Japan's first crypto approval in four years
Crypto.reason: Regulatory approval for a Nomura-backed provider is a concrete institutional-adoption positive, especially for onshore Asian markets.

Crypto.title: Coldcard ships firmware after $114 million bitcoin theft; says AI helped catch more bugs
Crypto.reason: Large custody/theft event signals security risks for custodians and holders; remediation and AI detection are constructive but net a modest negative.
